revenue_source_agreement_claim.claim: pos_transactions.gross_revenue and finance_gl_extract.gl_revenue_usd agree on revenue for the same region-month, within tolerance

refutes_if.rationale: A systematic gap this size can't be sampling noise across every region-month -- it means the two sources are computing revenue on different definitions.

revenue_source_agreement_claim.explanation: Systematic ~2.1% gap, consistent across every region-month (not random noise). Documented cause in the KPI contract: 'net of a 2% returns/discount allowance not applied in pos_transactions.gross_revenue'. Treat pos_transactions.gross_revenue as the analysis series (it is the declared system-of-record for the `revenue` KPI); finance_gl_extract is kept as a reconciliation check, not swapped in silently.

rep_attribution_bounds_claim.claim: rep-attributed revenue never exceeds total region revenue for the same region-month (a rep's book is a subset of the region it's in)

refutes_if.rationale: Rep-attributed revenue is defined as a portion of total region revenue -- a ratio above 100% means a join or aggregation step double-counted something, not that a rep genuinely out-earned their entire region.

rep_attribution_bounds_claim.explanation: Attribution ratio stays within bounds everywhere (max 14.3% of region revenue, in Central 2025-09) -- no double-counting detected across 27 region-months checked.
